 "description": "Emphasizes business-to-business (B2B) marketing and develops students’ ability to propose solutions to real-world challenges faced by a B2B corporation. Uses the help of an industry partner to present B2B concepts against the backdrop of innovation and partnership building. Offers students the opportunity to gain insight into a B2B company’s products, history, current marketing strategies, and past projects. Examines and contrasts B2B and B2C marketing and innovation, covers B2B strategy design and partnerships, and provides guidance on managing creative processes. Introduces students to a series of new challenges presented by senior management, prompting students to develop practical solutions and effectively present their proposals to management. Focuses on the process of developing innovative solutions for real-world challenges, including creating storyboards, designing content, and practicing professional pitches.",
